Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What is the price of Sky Dive Dubai tandem jumps?

At Phoenix Tours, the iconic Tandem Skydive · Palm Jumeirah Dropzone is AED 2,700 per person.

What are the weight and age requirements?

Participants must be at least 18 years old on the day of the jump. Weight limits apply according to safety regulations (typically under 100 kg for men and 90 kg for women with appropriate BMI).

How do I receive my photos and videos?

Professional handcam and edited video packages capture your entire flight and freefall from start to finish, delivered digitally right after your jump.
